stories.headline: Global AI Ethics Accord Signed by Major Tech Nations
stories.summary: Leading nations and tech giants agreed on a landmark framework for ethical AI development, aiming to prevent misuse and ensure responsible innovation.

stories.headline: EU-UK Trade Talks Stalled Amid New Customs Dispute
stories.summary: Negotiations between the EU and UK hit an impasse following new border checks, threatening supply chains and economic stability across Europe.

stories.headline: Promising Vaccine Trial Results for Tropical Disease in Africa
stories.summary: A phase 3 clinical trial in several African nations reported high efficacy for a new vaccine targeting a widespread neglected tropical disease, offering hope for millions.

stories.headline: Southeast Asian Economy Exceeds Growth Forecasts
stories.summary: A key Southeast Asian nation announced stronger-than-expected Q2 GDP growth, signaling resilience and potential for regional economic uplift.

stories.headline: Extreme Heatwave Grips South America, Causing Power Outages
stories.summary: An unprecedented heatwave across parts of South America led to critical infrastructure failures and emergency declarations, impacting millions.
